LESSON: READING 14.2.1 STUDY SKILLS: SUMMARISING

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 14
Topic 14.2: Reading 14.2.1 Study Skills: Summarising
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 14.2.1 Study Skills: Summarising, part of Strand 14 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to summarise information? 2. What factors should one consider when summarising an event?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify the main ideas in texts

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Reading 14.2.1 Study Skills: Summarising in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. write a summary of ideas from varied texts

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Reading 14.2.1 Study Skills: Summarising in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. appreciate the importance of summarising information in a given context.  Brainstorm on the steps to follow when writing a summary of a text. Learners with speech difficulties could use alternative communication modes as they share their views. Allow more time for learners with speech difficulties to express their views.  Read a print or non-print text on varied issues, including outdoor games, and underline the main ideas,. Learners with manipulation difficulties could use an alternative functional part of the body to perform the task. Adjust light intensity when using the digital device for learners with visual difficulties.  Make notes from the underlined sentences and use them to make a rough draft, 1. SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 14.2.1 Study Skills: Summarising together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Learning to learn developed as the learner summarises excerpts and makes presentations for peer review.

Values:
Responsibility is enhanced as learner undertakes the task of making notes from the underlined sentences and using them to make

a rough draft as guided.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Life skills as the learner decides on the content to pick or leave out in writing summary.

Link to other subjects:

Kiswahili.
